name: Honest Mole 71
author: arieshiphop
description: Gradient sky-blue button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from #1e90ff to linear-gradient(90deg, #1e90ff 0%, #00d4ff 100%).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Honest Mole 71</title>
<style>
/* Honest Mole 71 by arieshiphop — https://uiverse.io/arieshiphop/honest-mole-71 */
button {
 font-size: 17px;
 padding: 0.5em 2em;
 border: transparent;
 box-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
 background: dodgerblue;
 color: white;
 border-radius: 4px;
}

button:hover {
 background: rgb(2,0,36);
 background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(30,144,255,1) 0%, rgba(0,212,255,1) 100%);
}

button:active {
 transform: translate(0em, 0.2em);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
